title: Content & Engineering Architecture / Source Specification
relationship_to_adsense_sequence: Explicitly separate initiative. T26-T31 AdSense-quality sequence is CLOSED / HOLD and untouched by this phase.

executive_summary.existing_capability: None. No dataset, calculator, or sourced reference content for fastener strength/load capacity exists anywhere in the repository.

nearest_existing_content.issue: Hand-authored, uncited, round-number MPa figures only for ISO classes; no numeric values at all for SAE grades; not suitable as a data source
Static per-size/per-grade torque lookup table, no cited source, no formula shown; not suitable as a data source

executive_summary.primary_finding: The tensile-stress-area formula and general tension/shear framework are well-established and converge across every source checked. Per-grade proof-load and minimum-tensile-strength numeric values could NOT be cleanly verified from a primary source in this session (repeated HTTP 403s, corrupted PDF text extraction, paywalls, and mutually-inconsistent search-engine-summarized numbers). These values are marked UNSOURCED / NOT READY per the governing instruction not to fabricate or fill gaps with unverified figures.
executive_summary.architecture_reuse: Every schema, generator pattern, validator pattern, disclaimer, data-classification framework, and internal-linking convention needed already exists and is reusable without modification.
executive_summary.recommended_v1_scope: One tension-only Bolt Load Capacity Calculator, a small sourced property-class reference dataset, and 3 curated high-intent pages (M8/M10/M12) -- not a large programmatic cluster.

existing_repository_audit.finding: Thread geometry (diameter, pitch) and tap-drill data only. Zero tensile/proof-load/property-class fields found repo-wide.

Directly reusable, no changes needed. dataset.schema.json already defines the exact status vocabulary needed: verified | source_bound | pending_verification | unavailable.

validation_qa_requirements.pass_fail: FAIL if At formula applied with mismatched mm/in inputs without conversion
PASS only if a specific hand-verified example matches output to stated precision every run
FAIL if load<=0, safety factor<=0, or unrecognized designation/grade produces a non-error result
FAIL if any input combination produces NaN, Infinity, or a silently-wrong unit label
FAIL if any UI-offered grade lacks a corresponding sourced dataset record
FAIL if any pending_verification/unavailable value is exposed in a live calculation without a visible caveat
FAIL if metric/inch inputs mixed without explicit correct conversion
FAIL if new dataset does not validate against data/schemas/dataset.schema.json
FAIL if any new page lacks a self-referencing canonical
FAIL if an indexable new page is omitted from sitemap or a noindexed page is included
FAIL if any proposed internal link resolves to a non-existent page
FAIL if regenerating twice produces any non-timestamp difference
FAIL if any existing tapping/standards/size-cluster file changes as a side effect

publication_pass_gate: Every numeric value in the shipped dataset must carry status verified or source_bound (not pending_verification or unavailable) for every grade actually exposed in the live calculator UI. A grade with an unresolved sourcing gap must be excluded from the UI, not shipped with a caveat.
